name: Sayyid Muhammad
contribution: The 10th ruler of the Uzbek Kungrat dynasty in the Khanate of Khiva.

checks.lead: Sayyid Muhammad Khan (Turki and Persian: سید محمد خان; 1823–1864), was the 10th ruler of the Uzbek Kungrat dynasty in the Khanate of Khiva. He reigned between 1856 and 1864.
